description: This file defines the StreamedSnapshot class, which is a serializable message representing a stream of entity snapshots within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating, deserializing, and serializing snapshot data, along with basic object overrides.

classes.name: StreamedSnapshot
classes.description: A final class representing a streamed snapshot message with entity ID and JSON snapshot data, supporting serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new StreamedSnapshot instance from an EntityId and JSON snapshot object.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a StreamedSnapshot from its JSON representation.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the EntityId associated with the snapshot.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representing the snapshot.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the StreamedSnapshot to a JSON object.
